text:
Priya Patel: Planning release 2.4.1 — small perf improvements + safer quantized runtime. Target window: Tue 01:00 UTC (90m). Need canary + rollback owner.
Ben Chang: Can we do a softer canary: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 20m intervals? Route by customer-tier where possible.
Nora Li: Yep we can shard by tier. We'll route 10% to dedicated-canary for paid customers, keep free tier on hosted fallback.
Priya Patel: Good. TL;DR for internal announce: "Release 2.4.1: inference runtime stability and cost tuning. Deploy Tue 01:00 UTC. Canary 10%->30%->100%. Rollback on error_rate > 1% or p95 latency +50ms. Oncall: Chris. Rollback owner: Ben."
Chris Gomez: Oncall confirmed. I'll be watching p95, error_rate, and GPU mem. Nora will shadow for rollout.
Lila Hart: Add model pin and artifact: model=redwood/optima-q4-v3, artifact=sha256:deafbeef1234abcd. Also note there is a tiny tokenization change that is backward-compatible but call out in the internal blurb.
Priya Patel: Add that line: "No visible prompt changes; minor tokenizer normalization for edge-cases."
Ben Chang: Rollback plan: manual command `/deploy rollback --snapshot 9976543200` and auto-fallback rule: p95 > baseline+50ms for 5m => demote canary to 0% and page OpsPager. I'll enable the rule.
DeployBot: A dry-run can be scheduled. To run: `/deploy start --dry-run 9976543210`. Steps in dry-run: create canary (model=redwood/optima-q4-v3), set route 10%, run smoke-suite.
Nora Li: I'll open PR for rollout config. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1739
Priya Patel: Please include the healthcheck list: p95 < 300ms, error_rate < 1.0%, throttle_rate < 0.2%.
Lila Hart: Product copy note: update release notes with estimated cost delta ~12% and add a short note under Known Issues: "Minor tokenizer normalization could change token counts in rare cases, no customer-visible regressions expected."
Chris Gomez: Confirmed rollback owner Ben, oncall Chris. I'll post the standby schedule in the ops calendar.
Ben Chang: I'll commit auto-fallback rule and run the deploybot dry-run now.
DeployBot: dry-run started by Ben Chang. Reminder: during the live window run `/deploy start --thread 9976543210` to attach events to this thread.
Priya Patel: Internal blurb draft posted to #eng-releases-digest for review. Please comment if anything missing.
Nora Li: Left one nit on the digest: include 'what to watch' metrics (p95, error_rate, GPU mem, token-cost). Added.
Lila Hart: Also add a short ops playbook link: infra/playbooks/release-2.4.1.md. I'll add the artifact hash there.
Chris Gomez: I'll be in channel T-15 and on pager at T+0. If auto-fallback triggers, OpsPager will page SRE rotation.
Priya Patel: Final checklist: 1) Nora merges PR 2) Ben finishes dry-run 3) Lila updates playbook artifact 4) Chris oncall 5) Priya posts final pinned blurb T-1h.
Ben Chang: Dry-run green. Smoke-suite passed.
DeployBot: dry-run OK. Canary create simulated.
Priya Patel: Publishing pinned internal announce now. Thanks all, will post post-deploy recap in this thread.
Ben Chang: If we need to rollback: `/deploy rollback --snapshot 9976543200` and I'll own execution.
Nora Li: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1739 (merged).
Priya Patel: Closing prep; keeping thread open for live results.
Chris Gomez: Ready and standing by. :thumbsup:
